description: This Kotlin source file contains unit tests for the CallLogHandler component, verifying its behavior in handling call log search requests, permission checks, JSON parsing, filtering, pagination, and error handling.

classes.name: CallLogHandlerTest
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of CallLogHandler, including permission checks, JSON validation, filtering, pagination, and error handling.

classes.name: FakeCallLogDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of CallLogDataSource used for testing, simulating permission checks and search results.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_requiresPermission
methods.description: Test that handles call log search when permission is not granted, expecting a permission error.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Test that invalid JSON input results in an invalid request error.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_returnsCallLogs
methods.description: Test that valid search returns expected call log data.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withFilters
methods.description: Test search with specific filters like number, name, date range, and type.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withDefaultParams
methods.description: Test default behavior when no parameters are provided.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_withNullFields
methods.description: Test handling of null fields in call log records.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_clampsLimitAndOffsetBeforeSearch
methods.description: Ensure limit and offset are clamped within valid ranges before search.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch_mapsSearchFailuresToUnavailable
methods.description: Test that search failures are correctly mapped to an 'unavailable' error.
